items.exampleEn: She keeps her keys in her handbag.
items.exampleZh: 她把鑰匙放在手提包裡。

items.exampleEn: Don't forget to bring your swimsuit to the pool.
items.exampleZh: 去游泳池別忘了帶泳衣。

items.exampleEn: She wore black tights under her skirt.
items.exampleZh: 她在裙子底下穿了黑色褲襪。

items.exampleEn: I got dressed quickly and went to work.
items.exampleZh: 我很快穿好衣服就去上班了。

items.exampleEn: My swimming costume is still wet.

items.sentenceEn: Wait a minute. I'm not dressed yet.
items.sentenceZh: 等一下，我還沒穿好衣服。

items.audioEn: I put my phone, my wallet and my make-up in my handbag.
items.audioZh: 我把手機、錢包和化妝品都放進手提包裡。
items.questionZh: 說話的人把東西放在哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: Who is that good-looking man over there?
items.sentenceZh: 那邊那位長得很好看的男生是誰？

items.sentenceEn: It takes her ten minutes to put on her make-up.

items.stemEn: We're going swimming. Put on your ____.
items.stemZh: 我們要去游泳了，穿上你的泳衣。

items.stemEn: Hurry up and get ____. We're leaving in five minutes.
items.stemZh: 快點穿好衣服，我們五分鐘後就要出發了。

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, Nina goes swimming with her friends. Before she leaves, she puts her swimsuit, a towel and some make-up in her handbag. Last Saturday, she got dressed in a hurry and left her swimsuit at home. Her friend Kate gave her an old swimming costume.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，Nina 都會和朋友去游泳。出門前，她會把泳衣、毛巾和一些化妝品放進手提包。上週六她匆忙穿好衣服，把泳衣忘在家裡了。她的朋友 Kate 給了她一件舊泳衣。

questions.questionZh: 上週六 Nina 忘了帶什麼？
誰給了 Nina 一件泳衣？
options: 游泳池櫃台的工作人員

items.promptZh: 天氣冷的時候，她會穿褲襪。
referenceEn: When it is cold, she wears tights.
She wears tights when the weather is cold.
rubricZh: 說習慣用現在式，主詞第三人稱單數動詞加 s（例如 wears）

items.promptZh: 我在公車上撿到一個黑色的手提包。
referenceEn: I found a black handbag on the bus.
On the bus, I found a black handbag.
rubricZh: 用 handbag 表示「手提包」
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 found、picked up、have found 等）
「在公車上」可寫，例如 on the bus 等，放句首或句尾都可以
